$comment: Sprint 06 — deterministic repair-ticket conversion record. When a SOL_DIAGNOSE failure response (CAUSE_IDENTIFIED) is compiled into the Sprint-04 worker-ready repair contract (lcim.acceptance-contract via src/contracts/repair.mjs buildRepairContract), this record proves the conversion deterministically: ticketId equals the compiled repairId (derived from the source ask+response, so identical inputs produce identical tickets), sourceAskId/sourceResponseId bind the ticket to exactly one decision exchange, rejectedAcceptanceRefs carries the single diagnosed acceptance criterion (a sideEffectId of the authoritative semantic contract), and conversionDigest is the sha256 over the canonical deterministic conversion payload (decision content excluding instance metadata). The schema uses only the Sprint-00 engine subset; cross-field rules are enforced in src/sol/contracts/validate.mjs (validateRepairTicket).
title: LCIM V2 deterministic repair-ticket conversion record
